number.why: The reported ticagrelor-versus-clopidogrel HR is 1.47 with 95% CI 0.88–2.44 for the specified first-event composite at 12 months. Agreement includes the ruling's qualification that the served intention-to-treat label is not established: the registry specifies a full analysis set requiring available post-randomization efficacy data.

quotes.span: Primary safety and efficacy endpoints were time to first occurrence of any major bleeding event and to any event from the composite of myocardial infarction, stroke or death from vascular causes, respectively.At 12 months, overall major bleeding occurred in 10.3% of ticagrelor-treated patients and in 6.8% of clopidogrel-treated patients (hazard ratio (HR), 1.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.94-2.53); the composite primary efficacy endpoint occurred in 9.0% and in 6.3% of ticagrelor- and clopidogrel-treated patients, respectively (HR, 1.47; 95% CI: 0.88-2.44).
POPULATION: Full Analysis set which includes all randomized patients with available post-randomization efficacy data

entry.why: ACS at entry and a minimum age of 20 establish the adult ACS population. Enrollment in an Asian population planned for PCI narrows applicability but satisfies the packet's entry question.

quotes.span: The multicenter, double-blind, randomized PHILO trial compared the safety and efficacy of ticagrelor vs. clopidogrel in 801 patients with ACS (Japanese, n=721; Taiwanese, n=35; South Korean, n=44; unknown ethnicity, n=1). All were planned to undergo percutaneous coronary intervention and randomized within 24 h of symptom onset.
ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 20 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

missed: No additional finding changes the numeric or entry verdict. The numeric agreement does not validate the served intention-to-treat label.
